{
  "candidate_rtl": "module addr_calcu(
    input [7:0] address,
    input [7:0] ptr1, ptr2,
    input [7:0] b,
    input control,
    output [15:0] count
);
    parameter [7:0] base = 8'b10000000;

    wire [7:0] selected_pointer;
    wire [7:0] q;
    wire q_nonzero;
    assign selected_pointer = control ? ptr1 : ptr2;

    // q is explicitly truncated to eight bits.
    // For the default base, subtraction is just an MSB inversion.
    generate
        if (base == 8'h80) begin : default_base
            assign q = {~selected_pointer[7], selected_pointer[6:0]};
        end else begin : other_base
            assign q = selected_pointer - base;
        end
    endgenerate
    assign q_nonzero = |q;

    // Carry-save compression: address + b + q = s + 2*m.
    wire [7:0] s, m;
    assign s = address ^ b ^ q;
    assign m = (address & b) | (address & q) | (b & q);

    // Eight-bit parallel-prefix addition of s and the low eight bits
    // of 2*m. m[7] is retained separately as an upper-byte contribution.
    wire [7:0] y;
    wire [7:0] p0, g0, p1, g1, p2, g2, p3, g3;
    assign y = {m[6:0], 1'b0};
    assign p0 = s ^ y;
    assign g0 = s & y;

    genvar i;
    generate
        for (i = 0; i < 8; i = i + 1) begin : prefix
            if (i >= 1) begin : distance_one
                assign g1[i] = g0[i] | (p0[i] & g0[i-1]);
                assign p1[i] = p0[i] & p0[i-1];
            end else begin : pass_one
                assign g1[i] = g0[i];
                assign p1[i] = p0[i];
            end
            if (i >= 2) begin : distance_two
                assign g2[i] = g1[i] | (p1[i] & g1[i-2]);
                assign p2[i] = p1[i] & p1[i-2];
            end else begin : pass_two
                assign g2[i] = g1[i];
                assign p2[i] = p1[i];
            end
            if (i >= 4) begin : distance_four
                assign g3[i] = g2[i] | (p2[i] & g2[i-4]);
                assign p3[i] = p2[i] & p2[i-4];
            end else begin : pass_four
                assign g3[i] = g2[i];
                assign p3[i] = p2[i];
            end
        end
    endgenerate

    wire [7:0] low_sum;
    wire low_carry, negative_result;
    assign low_sum = p0 ^ {g3[6:0], 1'b0};
    assign low_carry = g3[7];

    // Subtract 256 exactly when q is nonzero.
    assign negative_result = q_nonzero & ~(m[7] | low_carry);
    assign count = {{7{negative_result}},
                    (m[7] ^ low_carry ^ q_nonzero), low_sum};
endmodule",
  "bottleneck": "The available evidence is the RTL structure, not a mapped timing report. Each original branch expresses an eight-bit offset subtraction followed by dependent address subtraction and addition, with output selection afterward. Carry propagation and upper-bit correction are plausible bottlenecks, but Yosys may already combine or restructure these operations; source-level operator counts do not establish mapped serial-adder depth. All inputs have equal external delays, so there is no evidence for treating control as uniquely late.",
  "rewrite": "Select the pointer first, then form q=(selected_pointer-base) modulo 256. For base=8'h80 this is only an MSB inversion. The mandatory truncated offset equals (-q) modulo 256, so its exact negative is q-256*(q!=0). Thus count is address+b+q-256*(q!=0), modulo 65536. A carry-save compressor reduces the three eight-bit operands, and an explicit eight-bit parallel-prefix network resolves the low-byte sum. The upper result is decoded from the two contributions m[7] and low_carry, rather than using a sixteen-bit arithmetic chain.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "The hypothesis is a shorter maximum data-arrival path through early pointer selection, carry-save compression, a three-stage prefix network, and small upper-result decoding. This also removes the final sixteen-bit output mux. No numerical gain is claimed: ABC can restructure the prefix logic, and the early pointer mux affects control-to-output timing. Compare maximum data arrival against the baseline using the specified mapping and OpenSTA flow.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Sharing the arithmetic should save area relative to duplicated branches, while the prefix network spends cells and routing fanout to reduce carry depth. The actual mapped area is unknown; compliance with the 1311.632960 um^2 cap is not established here. The candidate must pass full equivalence, mapped-area measurement, and zero-violation max-slew/max-capacitance checks before acceptance.",
  "functional_boundaries": "The module name, ports, widths, and parameter declaration/default are preserved. The design is entirely combinational and accepts all 33 ordinary input bits without restrictions. Eight-bit truncation is explicit in q and is retained algebraically in the offset correction; this is not an untruncated replacement of base-pointer. Since the exact result address+b-offset lies between -255 and 510, bits 15:9 are its replicated sign, and bit 8 follows the stated correction. The nondefault-parameter branch implements the same identity with an eight-bit subtraction, although only the default instance is assessed. Formal equivalence and electrical eligibility remain required EDA checks, not claimed measurements."
}
